question:
The line chart given below shows the income and expenditure of a company in five years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6ce9afa09fb5e25f1b0ec436b79361ebeaaa73bc54d9829e63e65d453b5e2f56.png] 

The income in years P and Q together is how much percent more than the expenditure in years S and T together?
solution: **Calculation:** Income of P and Q = 650 + 450 = 1100 Expenditure of S and T = 150 + 100 = 250 According to the question: (1100 - 250)250 × 100 850/250 × 100 85 × 4 = 340%
